definition_title: Parameter record for exponent-gapped rational approximants
natural_language_statement:
For a real parameter $
u$, the structure $\mathrm{Parameters}(
u)$ stores rational numbers $	heta,A,B,C$ and a real number $\eta$ satisfying $0<	heta<A<B<1$, $1-	heta<
u(A-	heta)$, $1<C$, $B<1/C$, $B<C	heta$, $C	heta<1$, $0<\eta<1$, and $0<
u(A(1-\eta)-	heta)-(1-	heta)$. The staged bundle includes the structure and its generated constructor and recursors, together with the theorem that every $p : \mathrm{Parameters}(
u)$ has $0<(p.A : \mathbb{R})$. This statement describes the contents of an existing record; it does not assert that such a record exists for every $
u$.
explanation: The record groups the rational thresholds and gap inequalities used by the approximation argument, along with the auxiliary real parameter $\eta$ and its positivity and gap conditions. The included theorem derives positivity of $A$ from $0<\theta$ and $\theta<A$. The bundle consists of the structure command, its generated declarations, and this positivity lemma; no general existence claim is made here.
